column1: # emu-profilegen 1.0 (ProfileGenerator, ledger U1510-U1512) - identity of the fwid text outputs - vmware_guest - SYNTHETIC: every replaced value is synthetic, not host data
# Rules (README.md / profile_generator.hpp): 3 MAC, 4a computer name, 4c GUID, 4d USB / HID serial (4b: PnP hashes exact),
# 6 EDID serial, 7a ProductId, 7b install instant, 7c user name, 7d SID, 7e volume serial, 8a-8e fwid 1.4 identifiers.
# columns: id, kind, rule, first anchor in the capture (file:line), occurrences in the capture's text files (fieldmap.tsv), value
# fwid writes '\' inside quoted strings as \x5C; values and paths here use plain characters. GUIDs in {UPPER} form unless
# the identifier keeps its own style (MachineGuid & co.). install_date = unix seconds, install_time = FILETIME (decimal).
# Enum\STORAGE\Volume instance paths (the volume GUID per rule 4c, the partition offset exact)
